explainer.title: What FORGE Is
explainer.desc: The whole program in under five minutes: being a stakeholder, the three phases and their gates, and the research FORGE is built on. For staff, visitors, families and new participants.

videos.title: Welcome to FORGE
videos.when: Plays right after the opening go-around.
videos.desc: Why FORGE exists, the stakeholder idea, what a FORGE mentor is, the three phases, and the elevator speech on screen. Ends on the stakeholder question.

talks.title: Why your worst deeds don't define you
talks.speaker: Shaka Senghor

videos.title: The Circle
videos.when: Plays first, with the talking piece in the center.
videos.desc: Where circles come from, the talking piece, and the five rules. Ends on the first round's question.

videos.title: Your Journal
videos.when: Plays at the journaling segment.
videos.desc: Why FORGE writes, the four kinds of writing, and tonight's prompt.

videos.title: Service Over Self
videos.when: Plays at "What Is Service?"
videos.desc: What service is not, what it is, and four examples from the dorm.

videos.title: Three Programs
videos.when: Plays at "Learning from Other Programs."
videos.desc: PEP, GRIP and RSVP, and the discovery they share.

videos.title: Thinking Controls Behavior
videos.when: Plays at the start of Part 1 of the Instruction segment, right after Review & Reflection.
videos.desc: The big idea, the Think-Feel-Act cycle one link at a time, and Man A and Man B side by side; ends on "What was different between Man A and Man B?" held for 20 seconds.

videos.title: The Thinking Report
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Practice/Exercise segment, after the blank templates are handed out.
videos.desc: The five columns, the guide's chow-line sample filled in column by column, and how a different thought changes the chain; ends on the exercise prompt held for 20 seconds.

videos.title: Thinking Errors
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Instruction segment, after Review & Reflection.
videos.desc: Automatic thoughts follow patterns and the patterns have names; the eight names appear one at a time; ends on "Which of these do you recognize in yourself?" held for 20 seconds.

videos.title: The Eight Thinking Errors
videos.when: Plays at the end of the Instruction segment, in place of the spoken wrap-up of all eight.
videos.desc: All eight with the guide's one-line summaries and the exercise instructions; ends on "Which thinking errors were in your thinking?" held for 20 seconds.

videos.title: Cognitive Restructuring
videos.when: Plays at the start of Part 1 of the Instruction segment, after the group recall of the eight errors.
videos.desc: Cognitive restructuring in plain English, notice-check-challenge-replace, and the three honest questions; ends on the three questions held for 20 seconds.

videos.title: The STOP Technique
videos.when: Plays at the start of Part 3 of the Instruction segment.
videos.desc: Stop, Think, Options, Plan letter by letter, then the guide's shoulder-bump example without and with STOP; ends on "The difference: four letters."

videos.title: Tools, Not Reactions
videos.when: Plays first, before the opening circle.
videos.desc: What Week 6 is for and the bridge from Weeks 2, 3 and 5 (thinking errors, the escalation curve, listening); ends on the check-in question: the last conflict you saw, and how well it went, 1 to 10.

videos.title: The 5-Step Model and the Heat Scale
videos.when: Plays at the start of the 5-Step Model deep dive (to 1:37); the rest (the heat scale) plays at the Heat Scale segment.
videos.desc: The five steps one at a time with the guide's techniques, then the four heat levels; ends on matching your response to the actual heat level.

videos.title: De-escalation
videos.when: Plays first, before the opening circle.
videos.desc: Heat at 7 or 8 on the heat scale, why de-escalation works (logic doesn't reach a flooded brain), and today's pieces; ends on the prompt to recite the five steps, no handbooks.

videos.title: Tactical Empathy
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Tactical Empathy segment.
videos.desc: The cellie example with three responses side by side, what tactical empathy did, the five key phrases and the redirect; ends on 'Validate first. Redirect second.'

talks.title: How to speak so that people want to listen
talks.speaker: Julian Treasure

videos.title: The Neutral Third Party
videos.when: Plays first, before the opening circle.
videos.desc: What neutral means and does not mean, why taking sides ends a mediation, and 'You're not the judge. You're the mirror.'; ends on the check-in about body language since yesterday.

videos.title: When Both Men Are Heated
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Managing Two Escalated Parties segment.
videos.desc: The guide's five steps for two escalated parties, from 'separate first' to 'take a break'; ends on 'Many conflicts are resolved between mediation sessions, not during them.'

talks.title: A hostage negotiator on how to resolve conflict
talks.speaker: Karleen Savage

videos.title: Problem-Solving Framework
videos.when: Plays after the opening circle, at the start of Review and Reflection.
videos.desc: Why the worst decisions happen in a few seconds and what this week builds instead; it ends on the guide's question about how fast your worst decision happened.

videos.title: The Six Steps
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Instruction segment on the 6-step model.
videos.desc: The FORGE 6-step problem-solving model on screen, step by step, then the five traps; it ends on "Practice it slowly before you can do it fast."

videos.title: Decision Making Under Pressure
videos.when: Plays after the opening circle, at the start of Review and Reflection.
videos.desc: What stress does to the brain, tunnel vision and the four defaults, and today's tools; it ends on "When the pressure hits, where does your body take you?"

videos.title: The 10-10-10 Rule
videos.when: Plays at the start of the 10-10-10 Rule segment.
videos.desc: The three 10-10-10 questions and the guide's two examples side by side; it ends on the pairs' quick-practice prompt.

videos.title: Consequential Thinking
videos.when: Plays after the opening circle, at the start of Review and Reflection.
videos.desc: Every decision sends out ripples to the people on the shoreline; it ends on "Who is standing on your shoreline?"

videos.title: Four Kinds of Consequences
videos.when: Plays at the start of the Short-Term vs. Long-Term Consequences segment.
videos.desc: Short-term and long-term, positive and negative, and the guide's worked example (escalate, or pause and walk away); it ends on "The choice that feels powerful in the moment is usually the one that costs the most over time."
